questions: Have you been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease?
Is the device you are wearing a pump that delivers Parkinson's medication continuously?
Do you experience tremor (shaking) in your hands at rest?
Have you noticed a gradual worsening of your walking over months to years?
Do you have stiffness or rigidity in your limbs?
Have you ever taken a medication called levodopa?
Are you currently taking levodopa?
Has levodopa improved your symptoms?
Do you experience fluctuations where your medication wears off before the next dose?
Have you had any falls?
Do you have difficulty with balance or feel unsteady when turning?
Is your voice softer than it used to be?
Have you noticed difficulty swallowing?
Do you have problems with constipation?
Have you noticed a reduced sense of smell?
Do you have vivid dreams or act out your dreams while sleeping?
Do you feel sad or depressed most of the day?
Have you had any changes in your memory or thinking?
Were you ever exposed to antipsychotic medications?
Have you had a stroke or multiple small strokes in the past?
Do you have a family history of Parkinson's disease?
Do you have any history of head trauma with loss of consciousness?
Do you have problems with low blood pressure when standing?
Do you have visual hallucinations (seeing things that are not there)?
Do you experience involuntary movements (dyskinesias) when your medication is working?

Hand pronation-supination test to assess for bradykinesia
Foot tapping test to assess for bradykinesia

- Vascular parkinsonism (lower-body parkinsonism from small-vessel disease)
